units.title: Result<T>
units.description: Domain methods return Result / Result<T> instead of throwing for expected failures.

units.title: Outbox
units.description: Integration events are stored with the data, in the same transaction, and delivered by a background processor with retries.

units.title: Inbox
units.description: Each integration event handler runs once per message, even when the message is delivered again.

units.title: Request validation
units.description: FluentValidation validators check the shape of requests before the handler runs; the domain stays the authority.

units.title: Idempotency keys
units.description: A retry with the same Idempotency-Key header gets the stored response instead of running the action again.

units.title: SQL Server
units.description: SQL Server, in a container from the AppHost or an existing server.

units.title: PostgreSQL
units.description: PostgreSQL, in a container from the AppHost or an existing server, with snake_case names.
